name: notification-server
description: Servidor simples para disparar notificações na app Bite Express

scripts.build: npm run build:shared && pkg . --out-path dist && npm run build:copy-files
scripts.build:win: npm run build:shared && pkg . --targets node18-win-x64 --out-path dist && npm run build:copy-files
scripts.build:all: npm run build:shared && pkg . --targets node18-win-x64,node18-linux-x64,node18-macos-x64 --out-path dist && npm run build:copy-files
